description: Stable identifier for a future SAR-only evidence unit. No unit is instantiated by this schema.
forbidden_interpretation: Do not treat schema rows as evidence.

allowed_values_or_format: scene id such as GM_RM011 or GM_RM017
description: Scene containing the future SAR evidence unit.

allowed_values_or_format: integer SAR frame id after a SAR-only exploration pass
description: First SAR frame covered by the future evidence unit.
forbidden_interpretation: Do not infer from optical frame numbers.

allowed_values_or_format: integer SAR frame id after a SAR-only exploration pass
description: Last SAR frame covered by the future evidence unit.
forbidden_interpretation: Do not infer from optical frame numbers.

description: Optional optical frame only after an explicit alignment protocol.
forbidden_interpretation: Blank means unknown, not no object.

description: Optional optical end frame only after an explicit alignment protocol.
forbidden_interpretation: Must not be filled by WGV1.4b optical continuity alone.

allowed_values_or_format: vehicle_like_scatter; temporal_continuity; boundary_support; competitor_or_multi_target_signal; background_or_static_reflector_risk; imaging_quality_or_motion_artifact; unknown_or_insufficient_evidence
forbidden_interpretation: A category is not a final prediction.

description: Whether SAR itself shows vehicle-like scatter/shape/energy support.
forbidden_interpretation: Optical vehicle evidence cannot fill this field.

description: Whether SAR-internal evidence supports continuity across SAR frames.
forbidden_interpretation: Optical thread continuity is not SAR temporal continuity.

description: Whether SAR evidence supports a boundary or separation.
forbidden_interpretation: A preserved optical boundary is not SAR boundary proof.

description: SAR-internal sign of competitor or multi-target structure.
forbidden_interpretation: Do not suppress competitor evidence to make optical identity fit.

description: Risk that the SAR signal is background, static reflector, or non-vehicle clutter.
forbidden_interpretation: Low risk is not a final annotation.

description: SAR image quality or artifact condition for this unit.
forbidden_interpretation: Quality notes do not confirm identity.

description: Permitted downstream use after SAR-only review.
forbidden_interpretation: Does not mean SAR-ready unless a later protocol says so.

description: Confidence in the SAR-internal evidence unit.
forbidden_interpretation: Confidence cannot be inherited from WGV1.4b optical stability.
Must not contain final boxes, GT boxes, revised annotation, selector, ranking, or runtime prediction output.
